sentences.zh: 对，这就完美了。

sentences.en: Steve, get all this down.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，把这些都记下来。

sentences.en: Steve, cracking up and going with the joke, starts typing.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫笑得合不拢嘴，顺着这个笑话开始打字。

sentences.en: Mr. P keeps fucking her as we cut to a shot of the live studio audience.
sentences.zh: P先生继续操着她，画面切到一个现场演播室观众的镜头。

sentences.zh: 然后画面切到南希·里根在白宫观看，罗尼从后面

sentences.zh: 它居然拼出了“祝你圣诞快乐，来自给我五”字样。

sentences.en: Everything's going to be okay, you fucking cunts.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好起来的，你们这群傻屄。

sentences.en: The end.
sentences.zh: 剧终。

sentences.en: Everyone is losing their minds with laughter.
sentences.zh: 所有人都笑得神魂颠倒。

sentences.en: It's not particularly funny, but these people have been up all night.
sentences.zh: 其实并不是特别好笑，但这群人已经通宵没睡了。

sentences.en: Boggs and Russell are practically crying.
sentences.zh: 博格斯和拉塞尔几乎都要哭了。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Why are we laughing at this?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么要在笑这个？

sentences.zh: 因为我们是一群他妈的智障。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, Cliff punches Russell in the face hard, breaking his nose.
sentences.zh: 突然，克利夫狠狠一拳打在拉塞尔的脸上，打断了他的鼻子。

sentences.en: Russell falls to the floor.
sentences.zh: 拉塞尔摔倒在地。

sentences.en: The laughter dies quickly.
sentences.zh: 笑声迅速戛然而止。

sentences.zh: 拉塞尔抬起头，惊呆了。

sentences.zh: 谁也不敢相信刚刚发生了什么。

sentences.en: Least of all, Cliff.
sentences.zh: 克利夫自己最不敢相信。

sentences.en: There's a long beat of silence.
sentences.zh: 全场陷入了长久的沉默。

sentences.en: And we hard cut to the Pendleton living room, the actual show.
sentences.zh: 接着画面硬切到彭德尔顿家的客厅，也就是真正的节目现场。

sentences.en: The live studio audience watches the Christmas scene.
sentences.zh: 现场演播室的观众看着圣诞场景。

sentences.en: Mr. P, what treat do you think Santa wants?
sentences.zh: P先生，你觉得圣诞老人想要什么款待？

sentences.zh: 全场爆发出巨大的笑声。

sentences.en: The audience eats it up.
sentences.zh: 观众非常吃这一套。

sentences.en: In the darkness at the edge of the stage, Cliff watches by himself.
sentences.zh: 在舞台边缘的黑暗中，克利夫独自一人看着。

sentences.en: The writers, Dave, Boggs, Sarah, Russell with his nose bandaged, and Jimmy, stand closer, listening to the laughter.
sentences.zh: 编剧们——戴夫、博格斯、萨拉、鼻子上缠着绷带的拉塞尔以及吉米——站得更近些，听着笑声。

sentences.en: Jimmy smiles, satisfied.
sentences.zh: 吉米满意地笑了。

sentences.en: It got a laugh.
sentences.zh: 收到效果了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: There you have it.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: Give me five.
sentences.zh: 给我五。

sentences.en: So funny.
sentences.zh: 太好笑了。

sentences.en: So moving.
sentences.zh: 太感人了。

sentences.en: Just a really incredible piece of work.
sentences.zh: 简直是一部了不起的杰作。

sentences.en: And that would just be sitting on the cloud or in hard drives, Carter and Craig's hard drives, if it was not for Dead Pilot Society.
sentences.zh: 如果不是因为“已死试播集协会”，这些东西就会一直躺在云端或者硬盘里，卡特和克雷格的硬盘里。

sentences.en: I think that's something that's worth supporting, that we get these shows.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是值得支持的，我们可以看到这些节目。

sentences.en: We bring them to life.
sentences.zh: 我们让它们重获新生。

sentences.en: We make them available for you to listen to.
sentences.zh: 我们让你们能够听到它们。

sentences.en: The writers get to hear their work.
sentences.zh: 编剧们能够听到自己的作品。

sentences.en: No one else is doing this.
sentences.zh: 没有人在做这种事了。

sentences.en: I hope you're motivated to become a part of the Dead Pilots Society by going to MaximumFun.org slash join Dead Pilots and becoming a member.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们有动力去访问 MaximumFun.org slash join Dead Pilots 并成为会员，从而加入死飞行员协会。

sentences.en: Or if you're already a member, think about boosting or upgrading.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你已经是会员，请考虑增加会费或升级。

sentences.en: We've got a great year of pilots we're going to be bringing you.
sentences.zh: 我们将为您带来精彩的一年飞行员剧本。

sentences.en: And we'd love for your support as a member.
sentences.zh: 我们希望得到您作为会员的支持。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: We'll be back with a lot more this week,
sentences.zh: 我们这周将会带回更多精彩内容，

sentences.en: including the second half of my interview with Carter and Craig and more of our countdown of the top five funniest cold opens in Dead Pilot Society history.
sentences.zh: 包括我和卡特以及克雷格访谈的下半部分，还有我们盘点《死飞行员协会》历史上最搞笑开场白前五名的倒计时。

sentences.en: OK, you'll be hearing more from me very soon.
sentences.zh: 好的，你们很快就会再次听到我的声音。

sentences.en: But thanks so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: I'm Andrew Reich.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁·赖希。

sentences.en: Until next time, take care.
sentences.zh: 直到下次，保重。
